hero.tagline: I turn ideas into plans, and plans into programmes that people remember.

paragraphs: I’m an Economics graduate from IIUM who loves taking an idea from a blank page all the way to delivery. Seeing a programme come together from start to end is still my favourite feeling.

Today, I’m a Graduate Trainee in the Commercial, Strategy & Growth team of UEM Edgenta’s Managing Director’s Office, working on business planning, market research and business development. Before that, I spent seven months in the Securities Commission Malaysia’s investED Leadership Programme.

At university, I led around 40 programmes, from a humanitarian mission in Aceh to community programmes across Malaysia, and learnt that a plan only matters when people believe in it and deliver it together.

projects.title: Misi Kemanusiaan: Denyut Nadi Aceh
projects.summary: An international humanitarian mission to improve facilities at a rural pesantren of about 500 students.
projects.description: At Pesantren Ar-Rabwah, more than 100 students and teachers were sharing a single bathroom. Together with Global Peace Mission Malaysia, our team planned and delivered a mission to improve the school’s facilities, especially its bathrooms, and to make the school a brighter place to learn.
results: Raised about RM30,000 within one month
Partners: Global Peace Mission Malaysia, Pertubuhan KAB and Dana Kita
Featured on Bernama TV, in international media and in Kosmo!

projects.title: Baling Here We Go!
projects.summary: A community and education programme with the District Education Office of Baling.
projects.description: Organised by the Mahallah Sumayyah Representative Committee, this three-day programme took our team to Baling to work with local schools and communities, with a focus on reviving young people’s spirit to pursue knowledge.
results: Delivered in collaboration with the District Education Office of Baling
Featured in IIUM News: “Membugar semangat generasi muda untuk menuntut ilmu”

projects.title: UNODC Youth Forum 2024
projects.location: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
projects.summary: Represented Malaysia among 35 youth delegates from 27 countries.
projects.description: Selected to represent Malaysia at an international youth policy forum, contributing to discussions on evidence-based policy development and on safer, healthier environments for young people, in support of the Sustainable Development Goals.
results: One of 35 youth delegates from 27 countries
Took part in policy-making sessions, workshops and dialogues

projects.title: Inter-Mahallah Sports Carnival (ISC) 2023
projects.summary: A university-wide sports carnival themed “Sporting Excellence for a Sustainable Community”.
projects.description: ISC returned in 2023 for the first time since 2019. All 17 mahallahs competed across more than ten sports, from netball and football to frisbee and sepak takraw, with a focus on wellbeing, inclusion and community.
results: Co-organised with the Sports Development Centre

projects.title: JASA Mentoring Series 3: Kembara Cilik
projects.summary: A mentoring programme by Jalinan Siswa Bersama Masyarakat Asli (JASA) for primary school students.
projects.description: Our team spent four days at SK Putra teaching soft skills through hands-on activities in leadership, teamwork and emotional intelligence, helping 36 students discover their potential.
results: 36 students mentored, with 70 participants in total
Sponsored by Salihin Future Foundation and Mulhaq

projects.title: Connect: Les Merdeka
projects.summary: A national unity programme celebrating Merdeka, online and with IIUM Educare’s young learners.
projects.description: Run by Sekretariat Rukun Negara UIAM with the IIUM Uniform Bodies, the programme combined a social media campaign with activities at IIUM Educare, where children sang patriotic songs and played games that built a love for the country from a young age.
results: Almost every campaign post passed 1,000 views
